chunks: And it was narrated from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام about a man who died and did not perform the Hajj of Islam, and did not make a will concerning it. Should it be performed on his behalf?

key_terms.أَ يُقْضَى عَنْهُ: should it be fulfilled or performed on his behalf
key_terms.حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ: the obligatory Hajj required in Islam
key_terms.لَمْ يُوصِ بِهَا: he did not make a will concerning it

ai.seo_question: Should the obligatory Hajj be performed on behalf of someone who died without doing it and left no will?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a person dies without having performed the obligatory Hajj of Islam and did not leave a will about it, the Hajj is still to be performed on his behalf. It indicates the continuing obligation of the missed Hajj and its fulfillment after death.
